<text:style bold="true">Quotes</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="10" wrap="none"></image:base64>

A quote is a dimension: it shows a measure and, at the same time, it is a
constraint, because the measure can be changed. Double-click the label of a quote to
give a new value: the drawing follows. Quotes are drawn in the PNG and SVG files
too, unless the quote is marked "Only as reference". The unit shown follows the
scale factor of the layer.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Radial quote</text:style>
Select a circle or an ellipse and press the button: it shows (and sets) the
radius, or the diameter if so chosen in the properties.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly
       one circle or ellipse is selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Linear quote</text:style>
Select a line or a side, two points, or a point and a line: it shows the
distance. In the properties the quote can follow the line, or be only
       horizontal or only vertical.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> one line or side is selected, or
       two points, or a point and a line (a side of a rectangle too).

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Angular quote</text:style>
Select two lines or sides and press the button; then move the mouse to choose
which of the four angles is measured and click to place the quote (Esc
       cancels).<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly two lines or sides are selected.
